{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check that we now have one row per patient
assert len(df_dedup) == 800, "Deduplication did not result in one row per patient"

# Now, correct the assay_batch B values: divide by 10 to convert from µg/L to ng/mL
df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= 10

# Compute the mean of the corrected biomarker_final
total_mean = df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()

# Print the result
total_mean"}
